issues.description: Inconsistent method name for the animal feeding sound: the UML and reference implementation define an abstract method named messageOnFeed(), and Farm.java in the solution calls animal.messageOnFeed(). However, several places in the problem statement (Part 2 tasks for Seal/Pig/Goat and the feedAllAnimals() description) refer to the same concept using the name getFeedingSound(). This naming mismatch (messageOnFeed vs getFeedingSound) will confuse students about which method to implement and which name Farm.feedAllAnimals()/the tests expect, and may cause students' submissions to fail automated checks if they follow the wrong name.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the method name across all artifacts. Preferred fix: update problem_statement.md (Part 2 tasks and feedAllAnimals description) to use messageOnFeed() instead of getFeedingSound(), and update any template comments that mention getFeedingSound(). Alternatively, if getFeedingSound() is preferred, rename the abstract method and all implementations/call sites in the solution and template from messageOnFeed() to getFeedingSound(), and update the UML in the problem statement. Ensure the problem text, UML, template, and tests all use the exact same identifier.
